statement_en: Show that there exist δ > 0, a strictly increasing sequence u(0) < u(1) < … of natural numbers with u(j) > (1 + δ)(j + 1) log(j + 1) for every j, and residues r(j), such that the number of x in {0, …, u(j) − 1} lying in none of the classes r(l) mod u(l) for l ≤ j is o(j) as j → ∞.
statement_lean:
theorem erdos_83341 :
    ∃ (u r : ℕ → ℕ) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ ∧ StrictMono u ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, (1 + δ) * ((j : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log ((j : ℝ) + 1) < (u j : ℝ)) ∧
      Asymptotics.IsLittleO Filter.atTop
        (fun j : ℕ =>
          (((Finset.range (u j)).filter
              (fun x => ∀ l ≤ j, x % u l ≠ r l % u l)).card : ℝ))
        (fun j : ℕ => (j : ℝ) + 1) := by
  sorry
